## Checked

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npx tsc -b`, `npm run test`, `npm run build`, `npm run bundle:check`
- [ ] New logic is in a plain TypeScript module with a unit test
- [ ] New screens or maps have a text equivalent, keyboard use and reduced-motion handling
- [ ] No secret, guest detail or personal data in code, logs or outbound requests
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/README.md` index, runbook or plan if behaviour changed)
